section_summary.extract_value: This section reports internal consistency reliability for the BAS-2 across three country versions: Danish, Portuguese, and Swedish. Cronbach's alpha values are reported separately for boys and girls, ranging from .91 to .94, indicating strong internal consistency across all versions and genders.
